adds.title: Iron Man 3
adds.text: Tony pours out the story of his battle with Killian to Bruce, who falls asleep partway through and admits he is not that kind of doctor.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Pours his troubles out to Bruce, who dozes off.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Listens to Tony's story and falls asleep partway through.
adds.evidence: Post-credits scene (belongs to the film): Tony tells Bruce his story at Avengers Tower and Bruce falls asleep.

adds.title: Iron Man 3
adds.text: Tony makes Dum-E wear a dunce cap after a clumsy suit test, and after his house is destroyed he digs the wrecked robots out of the rubble and takes them with him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Gives Dum-E a dunce cap, then saves the robots from the ruins.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's robots, pulled from the ruins of his house.
adds.evidence: Dum-E gets a dunce cap during the Mark XLII test; Tony recovers Dum-E and U from the mansion wreckage.

adds.title: Iron Man 3
adds.text: As head of security at Stark Industries, Happy keeps watch over Pepper's meeting with Aldrich Killian and has her car ready when he leaves.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Tony's partner and the boss Happy guards during Killian's visit.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Watches over Pepper during Killian's visit.
adds.evidence: Happy tells Tony he is 'watching Pepper'; after Killian leaves, Happy tells Pepper her car is ready.

adds.title: Iron Man 3
adds.text: When Happy is left in a coma by a bombing blamed on the Mandarin, Tony sits at his hospital bedside and then publicly threatens the Mandarin.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Sits by Happy's hospital bed and threatens the Mandarin over him.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's old friend, left in a coma by a bombing.
adds.evidence: Happy is injured at the Chinese Theatre; Tony stays at his bedside at Cedars-Sinai and threatens the Mandarin on TV.

adds.title: Iron Man 3
adds.text: At a New Year's Eve party in Bern in 1999, Yinsen introduces himself to a drunk Tony, who brushes him off with a joke about his name.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A drunk Tony who brushes Yinsen off at a party in Bern.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A scientist Tony brushes off at a party in Bern.
adds.evidence: Opening 1999 Bern party: 'Mr. Stark, Ho Yinsen.' 'Ah, I finally met a man called Ho.' Tony brushes him off for Maya Hansen.

adds.title: Iron Man 3
adds.text: J.A.R.V.I.S. flies Tony's damaged suit to Tennessee after the attack on his house, and later Tony has him blow up every Iron Man suit as a gesture to Pepper.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Orders J.A.R.V.I.S. to destroy every Iron Man suit.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The AI that flies Tony to Tennessee and destroys his suits.
adds.evidence: Wikipedia plot: J.A.R.V.I.S. pilots the suit to Tennessee; Stark orders J.A.R.V.I.S. to destroy all the suits.

adds.title: Iron Man 3
adds.text: Rhodey and Pepper stand together at Tony's side as he goes in for surgery to remove the shrapnel near his heart.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend at Tony's surgery with Rhodes.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend at Tony's surgery with Pepper.
adds.evidence: Rhodes attends Tony's surgery alongside Potts, giving Tony a thumbs up; Pepper watches the operation with Rhodes.

adds.title: Iron Man 3
adds.text: Tony and Rhodey team up to stop Killian, saving the President and fighting side by side on the oil rig.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Rhodes's best friend, who fights Killian beside him.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's best friend, who saves the President while Tony fights Killian.
adds.evidence: Wikipedia plot: Stark reunites with Rhodes; they infiltrate the platform, Rhodes secures the President.

adds.title: Iron Man 3
adds.text: When helicopters attack the mansion, Tony's Mark 42 armor, run by J.A.R.V.I.S., closes around Pepper, and she uses it to save Tony and Maya Hansen.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Tony's AI, whose armor shields Pepper during the attack.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Wears the armor J.A.R.V.I.S. runs to escape the attack.
adds.evidence: Stark commands the Mark XLII to form around Pepper during the mansion attack; she shields Stark and saves Hansen.

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
adds.text: Drax and Gamora go with Quill to Ego's planet, where she grabs Mantis for answers, Drax tells her Mantis has told him everything, and they fight together to save Quill.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who joins Drax in saving Quill from Ego.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who joins Gamora in saving Quill from Ego.
adds.evidence: Gamora attacks Mantis; Drax says Mantis already told him everything; the four plan to save Quill.

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
adds.text: Drax shoves past Baby Groot calling him dumber, smaller Groot, and Groot hits him in anger, but at Yondu's funeral Groot falls asleep on Drax's shoulder.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A tiny teammate who hits Drax, then sleeps on his shoulder.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Calls Groot dumber, smaller Groot, then lets him sleep on his shoulder.
adds.evidence: 'Out of the way, dumber smaller Groot!'; Groot hits Drax; at the funeral Groot settles onto Drax's shoulder.

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
adds.text: Drax goes with Quill to meet his father Ego, offers him advice on love, and refuses to leave him behind when Ego turns on him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Drax refuses to leave behind on Ego's planet.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Goes with Quill to Ego's planet and refuses to leave him behind.
adds.evidence: Drax offers Quill romance advice; when Nebula suggests abandoning Quill, Drax says they are family and leave no one behind.

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
adds.text: Rocket tells Drax he stole the Sovereign's batteries just before their fleet attacks, and later Drax protests when Rocket orders the ship off Ego's planet without Quill.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The teammate who tells Drax about the stolen batteries.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Hears about Rocket's stolen batteries, then protests leaving Quill behind.
adds.evidence: Rocket reveals to Drax he stole Anulax Batteries; Rocket commands Kraglin to take off, to Drax's objection.

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
adds.text: Kraglin flies the Ravager ship down to Ego's crumbling planet and carries Gamora and the others away before it explodes.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Ravager who flies Gamora off Ego's planet before it explodes.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A Guardian Kraglin flies off Ego's planet.
adds.evidence: Gamora and Nebula make their way to the ship piloted by Kraglin on the surface and escape as the planet is destroyed.

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
adds.text: Gamora leaves Rocket to guard Nebula and fix the ship, and when she tries to go back for Quill on Ego's planet, Rocket stuns her to keep her from dying in the blast.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Teammate who stuns Gamora to stop her dying for Quill.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Teammate Rocket stuns to keep her from going back for Quill.
adds.evidence: Gamora tells Rocket to shoot Nebula if she escapes; Rocket knocks Gamora out with his laser cannon as she tries to rescue Quill.

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
adds.text: Baby Groot plants the bomb that kills Ego while Quill holds his father off, and years later Quill scolds a sulky teenage Groot for his messy room.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who scolds a teenage Groot about his messy room.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Plants the bomb that kills Ego, then grows into a sulky teen.
adds.evidence: Wikipedia plot: Groot plants the bomb while Quill distracts Ego; mid-credits scene with adolescent Groot and Quill.

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
adds.text: Quill and Rocket argue after Rocket's theft gets the ship shot down, but Rocket comes to Ego's planet to rescue Quill and builds the bomb that kills Ego.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who argues with Quill, then helps save him from Ego.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Argues with Rocket, who then helps save him from Ego.
adds.evidence: Quill and Rocket argue during the escape; Rocket arrives on Ego's planet and makes the bomb from the batteries.

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
adds.text: Kraglin steadies the Ravager ship so Drax can carry Mantis aboard as Ego's planet falls apart, and later, practicing with Yondu's arrow, he accidentally stabs Drax with it.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Ravager who lifts Drax off Ego's planet, then stabs him by mistake.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A Guardian Kraglin rescues, then accidentally stabs with Yondu's arrow.
adds.evidence: Kraglin stabilizes the ship for Drax and Mantis; post-credits, he fires the Yaka Arrow into Drax's chest by accident.

none.title: Iron Man 3
none.why: Bruce appears only in the closing scene with Tony; J.A.R.V.I.S. has no exchange with him.

none.why: Stakar deals only with Yondu and appears at the funeral from his own ship; he never deals with Gamora here.
